title: Microsurgical reconstructions for skin/soft tissue defects on the head, trunk, and upper and lower extremities at the BG Clinic in Tübingen: a retrospective data analysis
summary: In surgery, wounds should be carefully closed to prevent infection and promote optimal healing. However, depending on the extent of the wound, this is not always possible with a simple skin suture. In severe cases, wound closure can only be achieved with complex tissue transfer surgery. These operations are performed regularly at the BG Clinic in Tübingen. To date, demographic data and clinical course data for these patients have not yet been evaluated. By evaluating our patient data, we hope to provide even better care for patients with large wounds.

interventions.name: Retrospective evaluation of data recorded in the patient files of patients who underwent free flap surgery at the BG Unfallklinik Tübingen between January 2017 and August 2024.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients whose cases were coded using ICD10 or OPs codes during treatment, indicating skin and soft tissue defects on the body (head, trunk, upper extremities, and lower extremities) or treatment using free flap plasty.
Exclusion criteria:
none
